capabilities: Reads terms and explanations from a chosen glossary note
Marks whole-word term occurrences in reading and editing views
Shows explanations and links in hover tooltips
Opens the glossary at an entry from a marked term
Rereads the glossary on save and follows note renames
extras: Desktop only. Read-only: it never changes notes, makes no network requests, and writes only its own settings file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define terms once and have their meanings surface wherever those terms appear.
summary: Reads a glossary note and marks defined terms across your notes, showing explanations in hover tooltips.
